   DigitalMango — shared site styles
   ─────────────────────────────────────────── */

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

:root {
  --cream:  #F6EFE3;
  --forest: #1F3B36;
  --mango:  #E8A02A;
  --honey:  #F2C56B;
  --leaf:   #6B8A4E;
  --clay:   #C8643D;
  --muted:  #7a7060;
  --ink:    #1a1a18;
}

html { scroll-behavior: smooth; }
body {
  background: var(--cream);
  color: var(--forest);
  font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.65;
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* ── SCROLL PROGRESS ── */
.scroll-progress {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; height: 2px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--mango), var(--clay), var(--leaf));
  width: 0%; z-index: 200; transition: width .08s linear;
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(232,160,42,0.6);
}

/* ── CURSOR SPOTLIGHT ── */
.spotlight {
  position: fixed; pointer-events: none; z-index: 5;
  width: 520px; height: 520px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(232,160,42,0.18) 0%, rgba(232,160,42,0) 65%);
  transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
  transition: opacity .4s; opacity: 0;
  mix-blend-mode: multiply;
}
.spotlight.on { opacity: 1; }

/* ── REVEAL ── */
.reveal { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(28px); transition: opacity .8s ease, transform .8s ease; }
.reveal.in { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .reveal { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; }
  .hero-badge, .hero-headline, .hero-bottom, .hero-right { opacity: 1 !important; animation: none !important; }
  .now-widget { transform: none !important; opacity: 1 !important; }
}

/* ── NOW WIDGET ── */
.now-widget {
  position: fixed; bottom: 22px; left: 22px; z-index: 90;
  background: var(--forest); color: var(--cream);
  border-radius: 18px; padding: 12px 16px 12px 14px;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 12px 40px rgba(31,59,54,0.25);
  font-size: 12px; max-width: 280px;
  transform: translateY(140%); opacity: 0;
  transition: transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), opacity .6s;
  border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
}
.now-widget.up { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; }
.now-disc {
  width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--mango);
  display: grid; place-items: center;
  position: relative; flex-shrink: 0;
  animation: spin 8s linear infinite;
}
.now-disc::before { content:''; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--forest); }
.now-disc::after { content:''; position:absolute; inset: 4px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px dashed rgba(31,59,54,0.35); }
@keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
.now-label { font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(246,239,227,0.45); margin-bottom: 2px; }
.now-line { font-family:'Instrument Serif', serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 14px; color: var(--honey); line-height: 1.25; }
.now-close { background:none; border:none; color: rgba(246,239,227,0.4); cursor:pointer; font-size: 14px; padding: 0 0 0 4px; }
.now-close:hover { color: var(--honey); }

/* ── FLOATING PIPS ── */
.pip-float {
  position: absolute; border-radius: 50%;
  pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
  animation: bob 7s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes bob {
  0%,100% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-22px) rotate(8deg); }
}

/* ── NAV ── */
nav {
  position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 100;
  display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
  padding: 18px 48px;
  background: rgba(246,239,227,0.92);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(31,59,54,0.07);
}
.logo {
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.4px;
  color: var(--forest); text-decoration: none;
  display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
}
.logo-pip {
  width: 20px; height: 20px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--mango);
  position: relative; flex-shrink: 0;
}
.logo-pip::after {
  content: ''; position: absolute; top: -1px; right: -1px;
  width: 7px; height: 7px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--leaf);
}
.nav-links { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; }
.nav-links a {
  font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500;
  color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s;
  position: relative;
}
.nav-links a:hover { color: var(--forest); }
.nav-links a.active { color: var(--forest); }
.nav-links a.active::after {
  content:''; position:absolute; bottom: -6px; left: 50%; transform: translateX(-50%);
  width: 4px; height: 4px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--mango);
}
.nav-cta {
  background: var(--forest) !important; color: var(--cream) !important;
  padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 100px;
  font-weight: 600 !important; letter-spacing: -0.2px;
  transition: transform .15s, background .2s !important;
}
.nav-cta:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); background: #2c5048 !important; }
.nav-cta.active::after { display: none; }

/* ── BUTTONS ── */
.btn-primary {
  background: var(--forest); color: var(--cream);
  padding: 15px 28px; border-radius: 100px;
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  transition: transform .2s, background .2s; white-space: nowrap;
  border: none; cursor: pointer;
  font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
}
.btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: #2c5048; }
.btn-ghost {
  color: var(--forest); padding: 15px 28px; border-radius: 100px;
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none;
  border: 2px solid rgba(31,59,54,0.18);
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  transition: transform .2s, border-color .2s; white-space: nowrap;
}
.btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--forest); }
.btn-mango {
  background: var(--mango); color: var(--forest);
  padding: 15px 28px; border-radius: 100px;
  font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: none;
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px;
  transition: transform .2s, background .2s; white-space: nowrap;
  border: none; cursor: pointer;
  font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif;
}
.btn-mango:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); background: var(--honey); }

/* ── MARQUEE ── */
.marquee-strip {
  background: var(--forest); padding: 13px 0;
  overflow: hidden; white-space: nowrap; position: relative;
}
.marquee-strip + .marquee-strip {
  background: var(--mango); border-top: 1px solid rgba(31,59,54,0.15);
  padding: 10px 0;
}
.marquee-strip.reverse .marquee-inner { animation: marquee-rev 28s linear infinite; }
.marquee-strip.reverse .marquee-inner span { color: rgba(31,59,54,0.65); font-size: 10.5px; }
.marquee-strip.reverse .marquee-inner .accent { color: var(--forest); }
@keyframes marquee-rev { from{transform:translateX(-50%)} to{transform:translateX(0)} }
.marquee-inner { display: inline-flex; gap: 40px; animation: marquee 24s linear infinite; }
.marquee-inner span {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(246,239,227,0.55); flex-shrink: 0;
}
.marquee-inner .accent { color: var(--mango); opacity: 1; }
@keyframes marquee { from{transform:translateX(0)} to{transform:translateX(-50%)} }

/* ── SECTIONS ── */
section { padding: 108px 48px; }
.eyebrow {
  font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); margin-bottom: 20px;
}
.section-title {
  font-size: clamp(38px, 4.5vw, 58px);
  font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.08; letter-spacing: -0.03em;
  color: var(--forest);
}
.section-title em {
  font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;
  font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; color: var(--mango);
}
@keyframes fadeUp { from { opacity:0; transform:translateY(18px) } to { opacity:1; transform:translateY(0) } }
@keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)} 50%{opacity:.5;transform:scale(1.4)} }

/* ── PAGE HEADER (used on inner pages) ── */
.page-header {
  padding: 160px 48px 80px;
  position: relative; overflow: hidden;
  background: var(--cream);
}
.page-header .hero-blob { position: absolute; }
.page-header-inner { max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; position: relative; z-index: 1; }
.page-header h1 {
  font-size: clamp(48px, 7vw, 92px);
  font-weight: 700; line-height: 1; letter-spacing: -0.04em;
  color: var(--forest); margin-top: 12px;
}
.page-header h1 em {
  font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif;
  font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; color: var(--mango);
}
.page-header .lead {
  margin-top: 28px; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--muted); max-width: 580px; line-height: 1.75;
}
.crumbs {
  display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
  font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted); letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600;
}
.crumbs a { color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; }
.crumbs a:hover { color: var(--forest); }
.crumbs span.sep { opacity: .4; }

/* ── HERO blobs (reusable) ── */
.hero-blob {
  position: absolute; border-radius: 50%;
  filter: blur(80px); pointer-events: none; z-index: 0;
}
.blob-1 { width: 600px; height: 600px; right: -100px; top: -60px; background: rgba(232,160,42,0.18); }
.blob-2 { width: 400px; height: 400px; right: 200px; bottom: 0px; background: rgba(107,138,78,0.12); }
.blob-3 { width: 300px; height: 300px; left: -80px; bottom: 100px; background: rgba(242,197,107,0.15); }

/* ── FAQ ── */
.faq-cols { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 560px; gap: 80px; align-items: start; }
.faq-sticky { position: sticky; top: 120px; }
.faq-sticky .section-title { margin-bottom: 20px; }
.faq-sticky p { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 300; color: var(--muted); line-height: 1.75; }
.faq-sticky .btn-primary { margin-top: 32px; display: inline-flex; }

.faq-list { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
.faq-item { border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(31,59,54,0.1); }
.faq-q {
  width:100%; background:none; border:none; cursor:pointer;
  display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center;
  padding: 22px 0; text-align:left; gap:20px;
  font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;
  font-size:16px; font-weight:600; color:var(--forest);
  transition:color .2s;
}
.faq-q:hover { color: var(--mango); }
.faq-chevron {
  width:30px; height:30px; border-radius:50%;
  background: rgba(31,59,54,0.07); border:none;
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  flex-shrink:0; transition: background .2s, transform .3s;
  font-size:14px; color:var(--forest); cursor:pointer;
}
.faq-item.open .faq-chevron { background:var(--mango); transform:rotate(180deg); }
.faq-a { max-height:0; overflow:hidden; transition:max-height .35s ease; }
.faq-item.open .faq-a { max-height:320px; }
.faq-a p { padding-bottom:22px; font-size:15px; font-weight:300; color:var(--muted); line-height:1.75; }

/* ── CONTACT ── */
.contact-section { background: var(--forest); }
.contact-section .eyebrow { color: rgba(246,239,227,.4); }
.contact-section .section-title { color: var(--cream); }
.contact-section .section-title em { color: var(--honey); }
.contact-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:80px; align-items:start; margin-top:64px; }
.contact-left p { font-size:17px; font-weight:300; color:rgba(246,239,227,.7); line-height:1.8; margin-bottom:32px; }
.contact-link {
  display:flex; align-items:center; gap:14px;
  font-size:15px; font-weight:400; color:rgba(246,239,227,.6);
  text-decoration:none; margin-bottom:16px; transition:color .2s;
}
.contact-link:hover { color:var(--honey); }
.link-icon {
  width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:12px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center;
  font-size:16px; flex-shrink:0;
}
.contact-form { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:14px; }
.field-label { font-size:11px; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:0.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:rgba(246,239,227,.4); display:block; margin-bottom:6px; }
.field-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr; gap:14px; }
.field { display:flex; flex-direction:column; }
.f-input, .f-textarea {
  background:rgba(255,255,255,0.06); border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  border-radius:14px; padding:14px 18px;
  font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;
  font-size:15px; font-weight:300; color:var(--cream);
  outline:none; transition:border-color .2s, background .2s; resize:none;
}
.f-input::placeholder, .f-textarea::placeholder { color:rgba(246,239,227,.2); }
.f-input:focus, .f-textarea:focus { border-color:var(--mango); background:rgba(255,255,255,0.09); }
.f-textarea { min-height:130px; }
.budget-pills { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:8px; }
.pill {
  padding:9px 18px; border-radius:100px; font-size:13px; font-weight:500;
  border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); color:rgba(246,239,227,.6);
  cursor:pointer; transition:all .2s; background:transparent;
  font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;
}
.pill:hover, .pill.active { background:var(--mango); border-color:var(--mango); color:var(--forest); }
.f-submit {
  background:var(--mango); color:var(--forest);
  border:none; border-radius:100px;
  padding:17px 36px; font-family:'Plus Jakarta Sans',sans-serif;
  font-size:15px; font-weight:700; cursor:pointer;
  transition:background .2s, transform .15s;
  align-self:flex-start; margin-top:8px; letter-spacing:-0.01em;
}
.f-submit:hover { background:var(--honey); transform:translateY(-2px); }

/* ── NEWSLETTER CTA (reused) ── */
.newsletter { background: var(--forest); padding: 110px 48px; position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
.newsletter::before {
  content:''; position: absolute;
  width: 380px; height: 380px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 35% 35%, var(--mango), var(--clay));
  left: -120px; top: -120px; opacity: .18; filter: blur(2px);
  animation: blobDrift 16s ease-in-out infinite;
}
.newsletter::after {
  content:''; position: absolute;
  width: 260px; height: 260px; border-radius: 50%;
  background: var(--leaf);
  right: -60px; bottom: -90px; opacity: .14; filter: blur(2px);
  animation: blobDrift 20s ease-in-out infinite -6s;
}
@keyframes blobDrift {
  0%,100% { transform: translate(0,0) scale(1); }
  50%     { transform: translate(30px,-20px) scale(1.05); }
}
.news-inner { position: relative; z-index: 1; max-width: 1080px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.1fr) minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 72px; }
.news-left .eyebrow { color: var(--mango); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; }
.news-left .eyebrow::before { content:''; width: 22px; height: 1.5px; background: var(--mango); }
.news-headline { font-size: clamp(40px, 4.6vw, 64px); font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.04; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: var(--cream); margin-top: 16px; }
.news-headline em { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; font-style: italic; font-weight: 400; color: var(--honey); }
.news-sub { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 300; color: rgba(246,239,227,0.65); line-height: 1.75; margin-top: 24px; max-width: 460px; }
.news-perks { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; margin-top: 28px; }
.news-perks li { list-style: none; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; font-size: 13px; color: rgba(246,239,227,0.7); }
.news-perks li::before { content: '◐'; color: var(--mango); font-size: 13px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.news-card { background: var(--cream); border-radius: 26px; padding: 36px 32px 32px; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 30px 80px -20px rgba(0,0,0,0.35); transform: rotate(2deg); transition: transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
.news-card:hover { transform: rotate(0deg) translateY(-4px); }
.news-card::before { content: 'no spam'; position: absolute; top: -16px; left: 28px; background: var(--mango); color: var(--forest); font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2em; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; transform: rotate(-4deg); box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.18); }
.news-card::after { content:''; position: absolute; top: -22px; right: 40px; width: 78px; height: 22px; background: rgba(232,160,42,0.45); transform: rotate(8deg); border: 1px dashed rgba(31,59,54,0.25); }
.news-card-label { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted); display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.news-card-label::after { content:''; flex: 1; height: 1px; background: rgba(31,59,54,0.12); }
.news-card-title { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; font-style: italic; font-size: 28px; color: var(--forest); margin-top: 14px; line-height: 1.1; }
.news-form { margin-top: 22px; display: flex; gap: 8px; background: white; border: 1.5px solid rgba(31,59,54,0.12); border-radius: 100px; padding: 6px 6px 6px 18px; transition: border-color .2s, box-shadow .2s; }
.news-form:focus-within { border-color: var(--mango); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(232,160,42,0.18); }
.news-form input { flex: 1; border: none; outline: none; background: transparent; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: var(--forest); min-width: 0; }
.news-form input::placeholder { color: rgba(31,59,54,0.4); }
.news-form button { background: var(--forest); color: var(--cream); border: none; border-radius: 100px; padding: 11px 20px; cursor: pointer; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; transition: background .2s, transform .15s; flex-shrink: 0; }
.news-form button:hover { background: #2c5048; transform: translateX(2px); }
.news-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; margin-top: 18px; gap: 14px; font-size: 11px; color: var(--muted); }
.news-meta .dot { display: inline-block; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--leaf); margin-right: 6px; animation: pulse 2.5s infinite; }
.news-meta-right { font-family:'Instrument Serif', serif; font-style: italic; color: var(--clay); }
.news-thanks { display: none; margin-top: 18px; padding: 14px 18px; background: rgba(107,138,78,0.14); border-radius: 14px; font-size: 13px; color: var(--forest); font-weight: 500; }
.news-thanks.show { display: block; animation: fadeUp .4s; }

/* ── FOOTER ── */
footer {
  background:var(--forest); border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
  padding: 64px 48px 32px;
}
.foot-grid {
  max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto;
  display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1.4fr 1fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 48px;
  padding-bottom: 40px; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07);
}
.foot-brand .foot-logo { color: var(--cream); font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-decoration: none; }
.foot-brand p { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 300; color: rgba(246,239,227,.55); margin-top: 16px; line-height: 1.7; max-width: 280px; }
.foot-tagline-italic { font-family: 'Instrument Serif', serif; font-style: italic; color: var(--honey); }
.foot-col h4 { font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--mango); margin-bottom: 18px; }
.foot-col ul { list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px; }
.foot-col a { color: rgba(246,239,227,.65); font-size: 14px; text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s; }
.foot-col a:hover { color: var(--honey); }
.foot-bar { max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto; padding-top: 24px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; font-size: 12px; color: rgba(246,239,227,.35); }
.foot-bar a { color: rgba(246,239,227,.35); text-decoration: none; }
.foot-bar a:hover { color: var(--honey); }

/* ── RESPONSIVE ── */
@media (max-width:900px) {
  nav { padding:16px 24px; }
  .nav-links a:not(.nav-cta) { display:none; }
  section { padding:80px 24px; }
  .page-header { padding: 120px 24px 60px; }
  .faq-cols { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .faq-sticky { position:static; }
  .contact-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:48px; }
  .field-row { grid-template-columns:1fr; }
  .news-inner { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 40px; }
  .news-card { transform: rotate(0deg); }
  .foot-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 32px; }
  .foot-bar { flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; text-align: center; }
}

<script>/* DigitalMango — shared site script */

function toggleFaq(btn) {
  const item = btn.closest('.faq-item');
  const isOpen = item.classList.contains('open');
  document.querySelectorAll('.faq-item.open').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('open'));
  if (!isOpen) item.classList.add('open');
}
function togglePill(btn) { btn.classList.toggle('active'); }

function subscribeRipe(e) {
  e.preventDefault();
  const form = e.target;
  const thanks = document.getElementById('newsThanks');
  form.style.display = 'none';
  if (thanks) thanks.classList.add('show');
  return false;
}

/* Scroll progress */
const sp = document.getElementById('scrollProgress');
if (sp) {
  window.addEventListener('scroll', () => {
    const h = document.documentElement;
    const pct = (h.scrollTop / (h.scrollHeight - h.clientHeight)) * 100;
    sp.style.width = pct + '%';
  }, { passive: true });
}

/* Cursor spotlight */
const spot = document.getElementById('spotlight');
if (spot) {
  let rafId;
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', (e) => {
    if (rafId) return;
    rafId = requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      spot.style.left = e.clientX + 'px';
      spot.style.top  = e.clientY + 'px';
      const target = document.querySelector('.hero, .page-header');
      if (target) {
        const r = target.getBoundingClientRect();
        const inside = e.clientY >= r.top && e.clientY <= r.bottom;
        spot.classList.toggle('on', inside);
      }
      rafId = null;
    });
  });
}

/* Reveal on scroll */
const io = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
  entries.forEach(e => { if (e.isIntersecting) e.target.classList.add('in'); });
}, { threshold: 0.12 });
document.querySelectorAll('section, .quote-band').forEach(el => {
  if (el.classList.contains('hero')) return;
  el.classList.add('reveal'); io.observe(el);
});

/* Now widget */
const nowLines = [
  'redesigning a café in Ari',
  'sketching a tour-operator site',
  'picking type for a bakery brand',
  'drinking iced cocoa, mostly',
  'rebuilding a real-estate site',
  'plotting next month’s slots'
];
const nl = document.getElementById('nowLine');
if (nl) nl.textContent = nowLines[Math.floor(Math.random()*nowLines.length)];
const nw = document.getElementById('nowWidget');
if (nw) setTimeout(() => nw.classList.add('up'), 1800);

/* Easter egg */
let pipTaps = 0;
document.querySelectorAll('.logo-pip').forEach(p => p.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
  e.preventDefault(); pipTaps++;
  if (pipTaps >= 5) { pipTaps = 0; pipShower(); }
}));
function pipShower() {
  const colors = ['#E8A02A','#6B8A4E','#C8643D','#F2C56B','#1F3B36'];
  for (let i=0;i<40;i++) {
    const d = document.createElement('span');
    const sz = 8 + Math.random()*16;
    Object.assign(d.style, {
      position:'fixed', top:'-30px', left: (Math.random()*100)+'vw',
      width: sz+'px', height: sz+'px', borderRadius:'50%',
      background: colors[i % colors.length],
      zIndex: 999, pointerEvents:'none',
      transition:'transform 2.2s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.6,1), opacity 2.2s'
    });
    document.body.appendChild(d);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      d.style.transform = `translateY(${window.innerHeight + 60}px) rotate(${Math.random()*720-360}deg)`;
      d.style.opacity = '0';
    });
    setTimeout(() => d.remove(), 2500);
  }
}
</script>
